hypothesis: Token streaming throughput to screen has a dominant parity-safe cost in one of four stages (provider parse, worker event channel, TUI render, PTY write); the lane brief (wave2/streaming.md) asks to attribute it, then narrow-optimize only if a real gap shows. Secondary scaling question (parent requirement): per-frame render cost may scale with loaded transcript length (full layout walk per frame).
approach: BASELINE ONLY, no code changes. Controlled fixture: scripted faux provider (PRIME_AGENT_FAUX_SCRIPT with engine:faux, tokensPerSecond-paced 3-5-char chunks, realistic markdown reply ~3.6KB/~893 faux tokens, unique end marker) driving the FULL production path: TUI -> supervisor -> worker (real AgentSessionEngine) -> coalesced session-event stream -> TUI frame scheduler (MIN_RENDER_INTERVAL 16ms) -> sparse-window transcript render -> ratatui cell diff -> PTY, all inside one 16c/32GB VM (xi5hltsa6c2r26laeo4jhslr). Driver: pty_stream_bench.py - per-trial isolated agent-dir+socket+daemon, pty 120x40, exact PTY byte capture, frame accounting via CSI ?2026 sync-update brackets, pyte screen-state per frame (needle sightings for TTFT/stream end), 100ms per-process CPU-jiffies/RSS/PSS sampler, pre/mid/post spin calibration, PI_REQUEST_TIMING=1 worker-side phases (controls with it off). Matrix: transcripts {fresh, ~100 rows, ~2k rows, ~10k rows} x rates {40, 200, 800 tok/s} x 3 interleaved rounds (38 trials total incl. 2 timing-off controls). Re-verified at new tip 6588b19cf with 8 additional trials (none/large x r40/r800 x2).

decision: HONEST NEGATIVE: no dominant parity-safe cost in the streaming path at 40-800 tok/s x 0-10k rows. All four stages healthy: provider parse ~0.1ms; event channel bounded by the (deliberate) 50ms coalescer flush; TUI render 0.65-1.0ms/frame and transcript-size-independent; PTY writes linear in rate (~100B median flush). The only latency knob is the 50ms daemon flush interval - a design parameter, not a cost defect; touching it changes wire cadence and PTY frame sequences (byte-parity oracles would differ) with no measured throughput problem to justify it. Lane recommendation: close the streaming lane with this record; the exit-flush O(transcript) finding and the faux engine:faux seam note are reported for disposition.
